chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Al-Sawiq builds the flesh and strengthens the bones.

key_terms.السَّوِيقُ: A traditional food made from roasted flour, often mixed with water or milk

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of Suweq according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of al-Kulayni in *Al-Kafi*, this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the medicinal value of *al-Sawiq*, a staple food often associated with the Prophet’s household. It reflects the Shia tradition of integrating practical health wisdom with spiritual teachings, emphasizing that simple, wholesome foods contribute significantly to physical vitality and structural integrity.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Al-Suweyq builds the flesh and strengthens the bones’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Bakr ibn Muhammad who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
sawiq grows flesh and strengthens the bones .’”
